artworks.title: Joannes Brice
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper half of an elderly man seated and facing forward. He has distinct facial features including prominent cheekbones, a slightly furrowed brow, a well-defined nose, a short goatee, and thin, receding white hair. The man is wearing a cap and an intricately patterned robe with a wide, white collar. There are no visible jewelry or objects in his hands. The background is detailed, with artistic lines and surrounding text indicating this may be an engraved or printed artwork.

artworks.title: Fulke Greville, First Lord Brooke, Poet
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in a three-quarter view portrait. He is standing with one hand on his hip, facing forward. The man has facial hair, a hat with a decorative band, and a ruffled collar around his neck. He wears a formal doublet with intricate detailing and a cape over one shoulder. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Cornelius de Bruyn I, Painter
artworks.artist: Gerard Valck after Sir Godfrey Kneller
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man facing forward, with his head slightly turned to the right. He has distinct facial features, long wavy hair, and is wearing a collared shirt with a draped dark fabric. The portrait is set in an oval frame with textured crosshatching lines in the background. Below the oval, there is a script or inscription.

artworks.title: Peter Brueghel
artworks.artist: Aegidius Sadeler II after Bartholomaeus Spranger
artworks.description: This engraving features a waist-up portrait of a man with short dark hair and a long beard, set within an ornate oval frame. The man has a solemn expression, high cheekbones, and a focused gaze. He wears a dark garment with a white ruffled collar. Surrounding the portrait are classical figures and symbolic elements. To the left, a female figure holds a staff and looks at a luminous object, while to the right, another female figure sits holding a trumpet. Above the portrait, a cherubic figure in a helmet leans over the frame. Below the frame, a seated human-like figure holds a skull and a trumpet against a decorative backdrop. The composition includes flowing drapery, fruit garlands, and architectural elements.

artworks.title: Johannes Theodorus de Bry
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man positioned slightly turned to his right, holding a piece of paper in his left hand. The man has a distinctive beard, mustache, closely cut hair combed back, and wears an ornate doublet with a high ruff around his neck typical of the late 16th to early 17th century. The background features a lined pattern, with books on a table in front of him, a stack of two books with visible title pages, and one book standing upright. A sheet of paper with handwritten text and an engraving tool are beside him. Latin text at the top and bottom provides details, including the date of the depiction.

artworks.title: George Buchanan
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of an elderly man, showing only his head and upper chest. He is depicted in a frontal position, gazing directly at the viewer. The man has a lined forehead, pronounced cheekbones, and a long, pointed nose. He has a mustache and a short beard, with thinning hair visible under the edges of a cap. He is wearing a fur-collared garment with a collared shirt underneath. No jewelry is visible, but the collar is secured. The background features an oval frame with detailed text identifying the man as "GEORGIVS BVCHANANVS" at age 76. The outer background has a textured pattern. Text below the portrait reads "Scotia fi Vatenn hunc gelidam produxit ad arcton. Credo equidem gelidi percaluere poli."

artworks.title: Arnoldus Buchelius
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man facing forward with a distinguished appearance. He has a full beard, mustache, and styled hair. He is wearing a high ruff collar, possibly a doublet underneath, consistent with 17th-century fashion. The background is dark with Latin inscriptions in a border.

artworks.title: Catherine Manners, Duchess of Buckingham
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a woman's upper body. She is in a slightly angled forward-facing stance, holding a large feathered fan in her right hand close to her chest. Her features include soft eyes, a straight nose, and a subtle mouth. She has soft curls framing her face, adorned with a headband. The woman wears an elaborately detailed period dress with a high, frilled lace collar, puffed sleeves with lace and embroidered patterns. She wears visible earrings. The background has a textured pattern of fine lines, contrasting with the detailed depiction of the woman. An inscription at the bottom introduces her as "The Lady Katherin, Marchioness of Buckingham."

artworks.title: George Villiers, Duke of Buckingham
artworks.artist: Charles Simonneau after Michiel van Miereveld after Adriaen van der Werff
artworks.description: The image shows a bust portrait of George Villiers, Duke of Buckingham, in an oval frame. He is slightly turned to his left, with a neutral expression and a slight smile. He has a long, groomed beard and curly hair, wearing elaborate clothing with lace and pearls. The background is dark and textured within the oval. Outside the frame, there are decorative elements, including feathers, and an engraved base with the name "George Villiers, Duc de Buckingham."

artworks.title: George Villiers, First Duke of Buckingham
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a man. He is depicted in a classic noble profile with his shoulders turned slightly to one side and his head facing the viewer. The man has a beard, a mustache, and medium-length wavy hair that falls around his shoulders. He wears an elaborate garment with rich decorations, including intricate patterns and a high lace collar. Two cherubs or putti are shown on either side of the oval frame surrounding the portrait, each holding an end of the ribbon that lists titles around the oval. The background features ornate scrollwork and decorative elements.

artworks.title: John Sheffield, Third Earl of Mulgrave, FirstDuke of Buckinghamshire
artworks.artist: John Smith after Sir Godfrey Kneller
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait showing roughly half of the person's body, from the mid-torso up. The individual is portrayed in a seated or standing position with their torso facing slightly to the right while their head is turned to face the viewer directly. The person has long, curly hair that frames their face, with prominent facial features including arched eyebrows and a composed expression with a slight hint of a smile. They are dressed in elaborate historical clothing featuring a lace cravat at the neck and a cloak or robe adorned with a decorative brooch or badge. A sash and a prominent order chain with a medallion are seen draping across the person's shoulder. The background is plain, with an oval vignette framing the upper part of the portrait.

artworks.title: Charles de Bucquoy
artworks.description: The image depicts an illustrated man from the waist up, looking slightly to his right. He has facial hair and distinct features, with receding hair styled back. He wears a ruffled collar and a doublet with a sash, all within an oval frame with text. The background has detailed patterns and an inscription below. The overall aesthetic is historical, resembling an engraving from a past era.

artworks.title: Charles de Bucquoy
artworks.description: This image displays an intricate etched portrait of a man from the waist up, who is facing slightly towards the viewer with a confident expression. The man has a beard, mustache, and styled curly hair. He is dressed in an elaborately embroidered garment with a lace collar and a draped sash. The portrait is within an oval frame with Latin inscriptions around the border. The background contains detailed patterns, armorial symbols, and decorative embellishments. The lower part includes inscriptions, scrolls, and geometric designs.

artworks.title: Charles Albert Bonaventure de Longueval, Comte de Bucquoi
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a man turned slightly to his right. His face has distinct features with a nose, mustache, and goatee, framed by shoulder-length curly hair. He is wearing a formal outfit with a lace collar and holding a baton-like object in his right hand. The background shows a detailed scene within an oval, possibly depicting a battle. The image is framed with decorative borders and a label at the bottom identifies the person as Carolus Albertus de Longueval.

artworks.title: Charles de Longueval, Count de Bucquoi
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a man surrounded by ornate engravings. The man has curly hair, a thick mustache, and a neatly trimmed beard. He wears a ruffled collar and a dark garment with a sash over one shoulder. Cherubic figures hold musical instruments around the portrait. The bottom half of the image features elaborate scrollwork with text and a landscape scene.

artworks.title: William Cecil, Lord Burleigh
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man within an oval frame. The man has a full beard and mustache, wearing a cap with a emblem and a detailed garment with a ruffled collar. He also wears a chain with a medallion around his neck and holds a rod in one hand. Below the portrait is a sculptural element with a cherub sitting beside a dog, holding a rod entwined with a snake. The background features architectural elements resembling a stone wall with intricate designs and the inscription "WILLIAM CECIL LORD BURLEIGH" on a plinth.

artworks.title: William Cecil, First Baron Burghley
artworks.description: This image is an engraved portrait of a man from the chest up. He is facing forward with his gaze slightly to the side. He has a beard and mustache, and is wearing a hat with a badge. He is dressed in elaborate clothing with a ruffled collar typical of the Elizabethan era. The man holds a baton and wears a chain of office, suggesting authority. The background is decorated with symbols, floral motifs, and Latin inscriptions. An inscription identifies the man as Sir William Cecil.

artworks.title: William Cecil, First Baron Burghley
artworks.description: The image depicts an upper body portrait of a man turned slightly to his right. He has a distinct face with prominent features, such as a high forehead, intense eyes, a sharp nose, a beard, and a mustache. His hair is short and closely cropped. The man is dressed in a richly patterned coat with a large, fur-trimmed collar. He holds a large letter "B" with his left hand and a small book or paper with his right hand. The background features architectural elements with ornate columns and arches, with “CORYNNA” and “RUTANIA” inscribed on the structure.

artworks.title: William Cecil, First Baron Burghley
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image portrays a man from the waist up, facing forward with his head slightly turned to the left. He has a long beard and mustache, with a serious expression on his face. He wears a cap with a brim and an elaborate garment with a high ruff around his neck and a decorative robe. The background features a patterned oval frame with the name "GUILIELMUS" and additional text around it.

artworks.title: William Cecil, First Baron Burghley
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man from the waist up, in front of an architectural backdrop. The man is standing and facing forward, holding a large book in his left hand while his right hand rests on the top of a sizable ornamental letter "B." He has a long, pointed beard and thinning hair on the top of his head, which is neatly combed back. His outfit is elaborate, featuring a high-collared, fur-trimmed coat over an ornately patterned robe. Behind him, the background consists of a detailed, arch-like architectural setting with columns and ornate carvings.

artworks.title: Willmus Burton de Falde (William Burton)
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man from the waist up. He is positioned with his body angled slightly to the left, while his head is turned towards the viewer. The man has a high forehead with receding hair, short hair around the sides and back of his head, and a trimmed beard. He is wearing a detailed outfit typical of the early 17th century, featuring a high ruff collar, intricate patterns on the fabric of his clothing, and frilled cuffs. He holds a pair of gloves in his right hand, with his left hand rested on a book on a table. The background features an ornate oval design suggesting a frame, with decorative elements such as a dragon and a crest with two lions and a crescent moon with stars. The text within the oval frame identifies the man as William Burton, with the year 1622.

artworks.title: Willmus Burton de Falde (William Burton)
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in formal attire from the early 17th century standing upright. He has a receding hairline, short hair, a neatly trimmed beard, and a mustache. The man wears an outfit with a high ruffled collar, a patterned doublet, and large lace cuffs. He holds a roll of parchment in his right hand, resting against his chest. On a desk in front of him, there is an inkwell, quill, and an open book. In the background, there is a detailed engraving with the man's name and the date 1622 inscribed around his circularly framed portrait. The engraving includes heraldic symbols, such as a dragon on a helmet on the left, three lion heads and two animal heads on the right, and a shield with celestial symbols below the oval.

artworks.title: William Butler, Physician
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated with one hand resting on a book. He is facing forward with a slight turn to the side. The man's facial features include a long nose, pronounced cheekbones, and a short beard and mustache. He wears an embroidered cap and a robe with a fur collar. The robe has buttons down the front. The man's hand is on a book. The background has an oval frame with inscriptions and a decorative scroll with text.

artworks.title: William Butler, Physician
artworks.description: This image shows a portrait of a person from the waist up, seated in a slightly turned position with hands resting one over the other. The person has a beard and mustache, and is wearing a cap with a pattern. They are dressed in formal attire with a cloak and wide collar. The portrait is in an oval frame with text along the edges, and there is a plaque below with an inscription. The background is an off-white, aged paper with an ornate border.
